maturity: max(A)+1 < min(B); max(B)+20 < min(Q); all Q labels mature before outer training
gate: both seeds nonlinear candidate beats no_adaptation, pretrain_adapt, non_tail and RW; candidate optimizer success and finite healthy encoding/operators; derivative and future-invariance tests pass
budget_matching: same outer maxfun cap and iterations; record actual objective calls and wall time, not equal FLOPs; inner non-tail has 8 mature A origins versus tail 8 B origins
market: never open price unless all gates pass; market execution requires separately verified safe prefix reader
limitations: small fixed synthetic grid; no novelty certification; no tuning generator or seeds
